1322 tests/test_init.lua
     101 tests/test_init.sh
    1423 total
1:-- test_init.lua — structural and behavioral tests for hammerspoon/init.lua
3:-- Run via tests/test_init.sh (which drives it through the Hammerspoon `hs` CLI,
4:-- since there is no standalone Lua interpreter in this stack).
6:-- These tests guard the bug classes that have actually bitten this file:
7:--   * a top-level local referenced by an earlier-defined function, which silently
8:--     compiles to a nil global instead of capturing the local
9:--   * the Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling
10:--   * unguarded hs.sound.getByFile(...):play(), which throws and aborts its callback
11:--   * chunk filenames sorted as strings, which reorders audio past chunk 999
12:--   * a modifier-combo trigger matched with `flags & mask > 0`, which fires on half
13:--     the combo -- every Ctrl-C would start a recording
14:--   * removed subsystems (meeting mode, LLM refine, silence auto-stop, ...) creeping back
16:-- Config (set as globals by the runner; `hs` does not inherit the caller's environment):
17:--   LW_TARGET  path to the init.lua under test (default: repo copy)
18:--   LW_OUT     path to write results to (default: /tmp/lw_test_init.txt)
25:-- Harness
30:local function record(name, passed, detail)
38:local function check(name, passed, detail)
43:-- Source loading + lexical helpers
46:local function readSource(path)
68:-- Blank out string literals and comments so scans don't match inside them.
69:local function strip(line)
79:-- strip() is line-oriented on purpose: in a Lua pattern `.` matches newlines, so running it
80:-- over a whole function body would delete everything after its first `--` comment.
81:local function stripBlock(text)
87:-- Word-boundary match for an identifier.
88:local function usesName(line, name)
92:-- Blank out identifier occurrences that are not variable *reads*, so the
93:-- use-before-declaration scan doesn't fire on them:
94:--   * field access / method call  -- obj.name, obj:name
95:--   * assignment targets and table-constructor keys -- name = ..., { name = ... }
96:-- A read of `name` on the right-hand side survives, which is what the scan wants.
97:local function readsOnly(s)
105:-- Sandbox helpers (behavioral tests)
107:-- Functions are lifted out of the source under test and executed against stubbed
108:-- globals, so the tests exercise the real implementation rather than a copy that
109:-- drifts. Every name the lifted function closes over in init.lua resolves to the
110:-- sandbox _ENV here, which is what makes the stubs and the after-the-fact state
111:-- assertions work.
113:local function baseEnv()
121:local function loadIn(chunk, env, name)
125:-- Source text of a top-level `local function NAME(...) ... end`, located by its
126:-- declaration and terminated by the matching column-0 `end`.
127:local function extractFunction(name)
141:-- Load a lifted `local function` and return it, bound to `env`.
142:local function liftFunction(name, env)
151:-- 1. Syntax
155:check("syntax: file compiles", chunk ~= nil, tostring(loadErr))
158:-- 2. Lua 200-local-per-function ceiling (AGENTS.md hard limit)
165:check("locals: top-level count within Lua's 200 ceiling",
170:-- 3. No top-level local referenced before it is declared
172:-- A `local` is only in scope after its declaration. A function defined earlier that
173:-- references the name does NOT capture it -- the reference compiles to a global read
174:-- that is nil at runtime, with no load-time error. This produced three live bugs in
175:-- the overlay code (X button, unpin, menu-bar pinning).
177:-- Collect top-level declarations: name -> first declaring line.
193:-- A name is "shadowed" before line `upto` if some earlier line binds it as a local,
194:-- a function parameter, or a loop variable -- in which case an earlier textual use
195:-- refers to that binding, not to the top-level one, and is not a bug.
196:local function shadowedBefore(name, upto)
217:check("scope: no top-level local used before its declaration",
222:-- 4. No unguarded system-sound playback
224:-- hs.sound.getByFile returns nil when the file is missing or AudioToolbox fails to
225:-- load it; indexing that nil throws and aborts whatever callback is mid-flight,
226:-- which previously stranded the overlay on screen. All playback goes through
227:-- playSound(), which nil-checks.
235:check("sound: no unguarded getByFile():play()",
240:-- 5. Deleted subsystems stay deleted
242:-- Each of these was removed deliberately. Patterns run against the stripped source,
243:-- so a mention in a comment or a string literal does not trip them -- only real code.
269:    check(sub.name .. ": no " .. sub.what .. " code remains",
275:-- 6. No unintended top-level globals
277:-- AGENTS.md: never leak state into Hammerspoon's shared _ENV, where another config
278:-- or Spoon can collide with it. A short allowlist covers the deliberate ones.
287:-- `decls` holds every top-level local, including forward declarations. Assigning to
288:-- one of those (e.g. `hideOverlay = function() ... end`) writes the local, not a global.
301:check("globals: no unintended top-level globals",
306:-- 7. Chunk ordering (behavioral -- exercises the real comparator)
308:-- The comparator is extracted from the source under test rather than reimplemented,
309:-- so this test tracks the real implementation instead of a copy that can drift.
